question.problem:
Given that the random variable $X$ has the probability density function

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{64}x(16-{x}^{2}),\, & 0\le x\le 4 \\ 0,\, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

its cumulative distribution function is 

$$
F(x)=\{\begin{aligned}0,\, & x<0 \\ h(x),\, & 0\le x\le 4 \\ 1,\, & x>4.\end{aligned}
$$

Find the function $h(x).$
question.worked_solution:
Since our random variable $X$ has a probability density function $f(x)$ that is strictly positive only for $0<x<4,$ the cumulative distribution function takes the following form:

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x)=\{\begin{aligned}0, & x<0 \\ {\int }_{0}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t, & 0\le x\le 4 \\ 1, & x>4\end{aligned}
$$

For the given probability density function, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{0}^{x}\frac{1}{64}t(16-{t}^{2})\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\frac{1}{64}(8{t}^{2}-\frac{{t}^{4}}{4})|}_{0}^{x} \\  & =\frac{1}{64}(8{x}^{2}-\frac{{x}^{4}}{4}) \\  & =\frac{{x}^{2}}{8}-\frac{{x}^{4}}{256}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the cumulative distribution function is given by

$$
F(x)=\{\begin{aligned}0, & x<0 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{8}-\frac{{x}^{4}}{256}, & 0\le x\le 4 \\ 1, & x>4.\end{aligned}
$$
